raw_mass.name: Raw mass
raw_mass.line: Returned mass. Make a core, a probe, or a shuttle from it. A dock can rebuild a lost craft.

nickel_cinder.name: Nickel cinder
nickel_cinder.line: Cut from Cinder Reach. Bright seams in dark stone. Make a Dart, Fang, or fighter from it.

ice_spall.name: Ice spall
ice_spall.line: Chips off the Aegis ice. Cold, pale, and leased. Make a probe, harvester, or beam bank from it.

copper_slag.name: Copper slag
copper_slag.line: Green slag with a copper heart. Make a Sting, Cheek Gun, or Beam Bank from it.

hull_plate.name: Hull plate
hull_plate.line: Torn plate from a broken hull. Make a gun, fighter, or tender from it.

salvage_parts.name: Keel salvage
salvage_parts.line: Stripped fittings. The tender brings these home. Make racks, heavies, and tenders from it.
